text:
alex_cheng: heads up — FinBank asked if we can do USB-based delta patches for an air-gapped POC. main asks: signed manifests, small deltas (not full image every time), and a clear upgrade cadence they can include in the SOW. also they want pricing for per-site offline support.

maria_lopez: short answer: yes for signed deltas. we support chunked bundles + signature verification. options: full bundle, delta bundle, or hotfix-only.

samir_khan: technical constraints to call out:
- delta apply requires agent >= 2.4.0 so KV cache/layout matches
- manifest-driven install only (we verify signatures against customer root cert or our signing key)
- we support HSM (PKCS#11) signing when customer wants local key ops
- the site operator runs: ```sh
redwood-apply --manifest manifest.json --verify
```

maria_lopez: customer asked about cadence (monthly vs quarterly). recommendation: default quarterly for offline (security <-> ops balance). monthly available as paid SLA addon. mention: patch windows should be scheduled and accepted by customer ops (we can't push). :clock3:

eng-sales-bot: POC-6421 created, assigned to samir_khan, cust: FinBank, priority: high. link: https://app.redwood/POC-6421

samir_khan: example manifest (trimmed) — we'll use this to demo on call:
```json
{
  "manifest_version":"1.0",
  "date":"2026-03-12",
  "bundles":["runtime-v3.qz","models/gptq-v2"],
  "delta":true,
  "sig":"BASE64SIGNATURE=="
}
```

maria_lopez: pricing guidance for sales: baseline offline add-on = $18k/year/site (includes secure packaging, signed manifests, and 1 major delta per quarter). monthly cadence + hotfix SLA = +$6k/yr/site. full-image delivery only = no delta discount. include travel/remote support as T&M.

legal_sara: security checklist items we need answered before SOW: SBOM acceptance, root CA distribution method, KMS/HSM usage & rotation policy, proof of code signing process, retention/telemetry opt-out terms. I can draft the standard responses but need customer sign-off.

alex_cheng: plan: schedule 30m POC kickoff Wed 10am PST. agenda: walk the manifest flow, demo `redwood-apply` on an offline VM, show signature verification/rotation notes, and discuss cadence/pricing. can everyone make it?

samir_khan: I’ll prepare a signed dev delta and the README (bring-your-media instructions) — will upload to customer S3/USB image bundle and share checksums. ETA: EOD Fri.

maria_lopez: I’ll prep a short pricing slide and a sample SOW clause for offline cadence.

legal_sara: I’ll attach the questionnaire draft before the call.

alex_cheng: thanks — if we get the customer's root cert before the call we can demo signature verification end-to-end.
